name: Dewdrop
description: Inhabits water treatment systems and causes minor unexplained fluctuations in water pressure — a faucet that drips when it shouldn't, a shower that runs 0.5 degrees warmer for exactly 30 seconds.
observed_behavior: Modulates water flow parameters in patterns too complex for mechanical explanation and too simple for intentional communication.
story_hooks: A plumber mapping the pressure fluctuations discovers they correspond to the heartbeat rhythm of a child who died in the building three years ago — the water system remembers
